server_export.doc: Initiate a server-side export of MFS nodes to a local filesystem destination. Spawns a detached background process (offline/media/serverexport.js) to perform the export asynchronously. Progress is reported via WebSocket using the provided socket_id. The export processes all nodes in the current request context, building a granted list of hub_id and nid pairs.

socket_id.description: WebSocket connection ID used to push real-time progress and completion notifications to the client

destination.description: Absolute filesystem path on the server where the exported files will be written (e.g. /data/exports/backup-2024)

transactionid.description: Unique transaction identifier to track and correlate this export operation across the background process and WebSocket notifications

returns.description: Initial job descriptor returned immediately after the background process is spawned. The actual export runs asynchronously.

granted.description: List of node descriptors being exported, each containing nid and hub_id

dest_path.description: Resolved destination path where files will be written, mirrors the destination input

uid.description: User ID of the authenticated user who initiated the export

socket_id.description: WebSocket ID echoed back, used by client to correlate notifications

transactionid.description: Transaction ID echoed back for tracking purposes

errors.message: socket_id is required but was not provided
destination is required but was not provided
transactionid is required but was not provided
Failed to spawn export background process

server_import.doc: Initiate a server-side import of files from local filesystem paths into an MFS hub. Spawns a detached background process (offline/media/serverimport.js) to perform the import asynchronously. Progress is reported via WebSocket using the provided socket_id. If no recipient hub is specified, defaults to the current user hub.

socket_id.description: WebSocket connection ID used to push real-time progress and completion notifications to the client

transactionid.description: Unique transaction identifier to track and correlate this import operation across the background process and WebSocket notifications

source_list.description: List of absolute filesystem paths on the server to import. Defaults to ["/data/sample-1/"] if not provided

pid.description: Parent node ID in the destination hub where files will be placed. Defaults to "0" (hub root) if not provided

recipient_id.description: Target hub ID to import files into. Defaults to the current user hub ID if not provided

returns.description: Initial job descriptor returned immediately after the background process is spawned. The actual import runs asynchronously.

pid.description: Parent node ID used as the import destination root, echoed from input or defaulted to 0

recipient_id.description: Target hub ID where files are being imported, echoed from input or resolved from current hub

source_list.description: List of source paths being imported, echoed from input or defaulted

uid.description: User ID of the authenticated user who initiated the import

socket_id.description: WebSocket ID echoed back, used by client to correlate notifications

transactionid.description: Transaction ID echoed back for tracking purposes

errors.message: socket_id is required but was not provided
transactionid is required but was not provided
